name: Overhaul update mechanism for reliable upgrades
description: The current update mechanism is clunky and hard to trust across multiple repos. As FADE becomes a core control plane, updates must be safe, idempotent, and transparent.

userStories.title: Idempotent updates with preview and rollback
userStories.description: Updating FADE should not corrupt repo state or overwrite user changes unexpectedly.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade update` is idempotent: running it multiple times yields the same repo state.
`fade update --dry-run` shows planned file changes (add/modify) without applying them.
Update preserves user-edited content in FADE.md and custom standards; templated sections are clearly separated.
Update writes a checkpoint/backup under `fade/update-backups/<timestamp>/` enabling rollback.
Update updates version markers consistently (FADE version, artifact versions).
